items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: So I got Squirrel Ashcraft and all these — and we formed the Chicago Rhythm Club.

ctx.x: Well you should. You’ll love it. So anyway, I’d never written a thing and Benny had never had one. So when he came he was interested and I said to the people at the Urban Room at the show in Chicago — I forgot the name of the hotel. But anyway I said to them well now listen, Benny Goodman’s coming, and he’s flopped all the way across the nation, until he got to The Palomar in L.A. And there they’d heard him, because they heard the late broadcasts. And I said, “It’s terribly important, that when he gets to Chicago…
